Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study uses both I-PISA (ion-based) and T-PISA (temperature-based) to probe drug target engagement. The primary biological variables are the drug treatments (small molecule inhibitors) and the temperature shifts used for the T-PISA/TPP arm of the experiment. The ions (ZnCl2, CuCl2) are used as the precipitation agents to probe solubility changes induced by the drugs, rather than as the primary biological perturbation variable themselves.
